title: Remove Files Larger Than 30MB
description: Identify and remove all files larger than 30MB across the repository.
summary: Identified and removed all files larger than 30MB (>= 30,000,000 bytes) across the repository. A total of 1,687 large files across tracked files, build directories, incremental compilation caches, and oversized test logs were removed, freeing over 226 GB of disk space. Inventory, deletion records, and verification status are documented in the ticket artifacts.
